summary: Sigma Lithium filed a Form 6-K reporting resumption of full mining-industrial operations after signing a TAC Agreement with the State of Minas Gerais. The agreement resolves environmental procedural adjustments, requiring ~US$1M capex and up to US$540,000 in fines for matters from 2013-2022. The company denies wrongdoing but will widen access roads. No securities transaction, merger, or strategic change is involved; this is an operational update with regulatory compliance details. There is no special-situation event, and the filing is routine in nature, with no deal terms or investor-focused action.
